sentence_stem: If only I had studied harder,
correct_completion: I would have passed the exam.
full_sentence: If only I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
acceptable_variants: I might have passed the exam.
I would have done better on the exam.

options.text: I would pass the exam now.
options.why_wrong: 'Would pass now' refers to the present, but the stem describes a past regret about studying.

options.text: I will pass the exam tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: This is a future plan, not an unreal past result after 'if only'.

options.text: I would have passed the exam.
I have passed the exam already.
options.why_wrong: This states a real completed result, which does not express regret about an unreal past situation.

grammar_focus: Third conditional with 'if only' to express past regret
explanation: After 'if only' with the past perfect, the main clause uses would have plus a past participle to express an unreal past result.
translation: Si tan solo hubiera estudiado más, habría aprobado el examen.
